description: Land Acquisition - Kossinna East, Gampaha D/S Division, Gampaha Disrict - Amendments to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2205/12 of 11.12.2020 - Palugaswewa D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land acquisition matters under the Land Acquisition Act. It contains detailed notices for acquiring specific land parcels (including lot numbers, descriptions, claimants, and extents) for public purposes, along with amendments to previous land acquisition notices. The content focuses entirely on land and property-related administrative procedures, fitting the definition of Type 4 (Land Gazettes) which covers "land acquisitions, transfers, or disposals" and "any gazette content primarily dealing with land, property, or real estate matters."
